 Follow Seattle police investigating possible DV murder, attempted suicide in University District
 KIRO 7 News Staff Sat, November 7, 2026 at 5:06 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Seattle police are investigating what they are calling a "possible domestic violence murder and attempted suicide."
 The incident was reported around 6:42 p.m. on University Way NE. The area includes several small shops with what appear to be apartments on top.
 It's unclear exactly what happened, but police say the incident is being investigated as a shooting.
 Seattle Fire said a 25-year-old woman was pronounced dead at the scene, and a man was taken to the hospital in critical condition.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement KIRO 7 has reached out to Seattle police for more information.
 People are asked to avoid the area.
 Police are not looking for additional suspects, and a University of Washington Alert indicated that there is no danger to the public.
 KIRO 7 will have updates as they become available.
